groups.rationale: Reviewed Mila M1 against trunk 8ef701ce: new mila/ client tree (Flutter app, mila_core, mila_transport) adds no Ash domain, resource, host or deployed service, so chapters 01, 17, 21 and 22 and the generated ownership and topology views are unchanged; Mila is documented in chapter 08.

Reviewed Mila M1 Marshall changes: Marshall.AppRoutes and the pinned/route fields on ls/show (ADR-0221, ADR-0222), the revised ssh-pin-guard-commands contract and the shared machine-state fixture now including paused labels. Chapter 08 gains the Mila section and chapter 19 the mila-sign-in-device-key and mila-host-trust scenarios.

Reviewed Mila M1 protocol changes: OverallsProtocol.AppRoute with the shared app_routes fixture, P-256 SSH key tests, command-line, host-certificate and machine-state fixtures consumed by Mila, and the push poke v1 vectors for ADR-0225. Chapter 08 documents Mila's use of them and chapter 19 records the scenarios.
Reviewed Mila M1 against trunk 8ef701ce: no lilly/ source changes; the shared chapter 19 change only adds Mila scenarios, which make no claim about Lilly provisioning, storage or guest behaviour.

Reviewed Mila M1 services changes: porsche/test/ssh_proof_test.exs adds a P-256 device key proof of possession; Porsche behaviour is unchanged. Chapter 08 documents Mila as a Porsche client and chapter 19 cites the Porsche proof run and the mila-porsche machine run.

Reviewed Mila M1 deployment changes: the pinned dartssh2 overlay and patch, Mila Nix packages and checks, libhegel-dart, devenv Flutter/dartssh2 link task and the language-versioned format hook, and the mila-porsche machine test in the catalog. Chapter 19 records the mila-porsche run; no NixOS service or option changes, so chapters 12-18 are unchanged.

Reviewed Mila M1 governance changes: ADR-0220 to ADR-0228 with index, the M1 architecture review, and check_contracts.mjs extraction of // and /// notes for Dart, Kotlin and Swift with its regression test. Chapter 19 gains the Mila scenarios citing the review.
